TEST REQUESTED
Fluorescence In Situ Hybridization (FISH) analysis for lung adenocarcinoma panel

METHODOLOGY
FISH analysis was performed on formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded tissue sections from cell block preparation. The following probes were utilized:
- ALK (2p23) Break Apart FISH Probe
- ROS1 (6q22) Break Apart FISH Probe
- RET (10q11) Break Apart FISH Probe
- MET (7q31)/CEP7 FISH Probe

Note: G-banded chromosome analysis was not required for this specimen.

FISH studies have been performed on the submitted specimen. Analysis is in progress.
